subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Bankrupts are those who are __incapable__ to pay their debts.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "incapable" refers to being unable to do something or lacking the ability or power to perform a task. (असमर्थ)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt incapable of completing the challenging project on time.
 
 
 
• **"Incompetent"** means lacking the skills, ability, or knowledge required to do something effectively. (अयोग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He was deemed incompetent for the job due to his lack of experience.
 
 
 
• The correct word choice "incompetent" fits because it indicates someone who is not able to perform a task, such as paying debts, due to a lack of ability or resources. (अयोग्य)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "Capable" **(सक्षम): Refers to having the ability or power to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** She is capable of handling difficult tasks with ease.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Powerful" **(शक्तिशाली): Refers to having great strength, authority, or influence.
 
 
• **Example:** The powerful leader made an impact on the entire nation.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Meagre" **(न्यूनतम): Refers to something that is very small or insufficient.
 
 
• **Example:** The salary offered was meagre compared to the amount of work expected.
